decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed extension, which creates a total volume increase of 28.11 cubic metres and includes:
?	Replacement single storey rear extension with a height of 3m, width of 2.5m and depth of 5.85m, that adds a volume of 3.31 cubic metres; and
?	Rear roof extension with a height of 2.5m, width of 6.2mand depth of 3.2m, that adds a volume of 24.8 cubic metres; 
as shown on drawing numbers 34BR/250/001, 34BR/250/002, 34BR/250/003, 34BR/250/005 rev B, 34BR/250/103 rev C and 34BR/250/104 rev B dated November 2002 and received by Council on 17 February 2003, is lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and therefore does not require planning permission.
Certificate of Lawfulness be GRANTED.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of roof extension and replacement of existing original single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
